cross_disciplinary_pairing.description: All agronomic outputs (intercrop spacing and plant counts, urea/nitrogen allocation with legume credits, rain-onset planting windows) are computed by deterministic agronomy code the model orchestrates via tool calls; the pairing is the product, not decoration.

test_prompts.prompt: I have half an acre and I want to plant maize and beans together on the same plot. How many plants of each crop can I fit, and what spacing should I use?
I farm 2 hectares of maize intercropped with cowpea in the Sahel and I could only buy 10 kg of urea. How should I split the fertilizer between the crops, and when should I plant for the long rains?
